{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Check how many QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) are in the loyal_completed group
qa_orders_in_loyal = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Count them
num_qa_orders = len(qa_orders_in_loyal)

# Exclude them
real_orders = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = real_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Print all key numbers
print(f'Number of loyal completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}')
print(f'Number of QA orders in loyal completed group: {num_qa_orders}')
print(f'Number of real completed orders from loyal customers: {len(real_orders)}')
print(f'Mean revenue of real completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue}')"}
